style.styleTitle: Personalised Name Rocking Horse Snow Globe by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Capture the magic of the season with this charming snow globe, crafted from plastic and resin. Inside, a delightful mix of fake snow and glitter creates a sparkling winter wonderland that twinkles with every shake. The base can be personalised with an engraved name, adding a special, heartfelt touch to this enchanting keepsake. Standing 10 cm tall and measuring 8 cm wide and deep, this snow globe makes a perfect festive addition to any home or a thoughtful personalised gift for someone special.
